description: This PHP class defines an HTML module for text-related elements in the HTMLPurifier library, configuring the allowed HTML elements, content categories, and their attributes for XHTML 1.1.

classes.name: HTMLPurifier_HTMLModule_Text
classes.description: Defines a text module in the HTMLPurifier library, specifying inline, block, heading, and structural elements permitted in XHTML 1.1 and their configurations.

methods.name: setup
methods.description: Initializes the module by registering various HTML elements and their categories, attributes, and special properties such as formatting and exclusions.
